name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Davao Leg 3
short_description: The final leg of the 2026 Davao Trilogy Run series, held on 27 September 2026 at Azuela Cove, Davao City, Philippines, with a 32 km centrepiece race plus 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Davao Leg 3 was held on Sunday 27 September 2026 at Azuela Cove in Lanang, Davao City, Philippines, with a 3am start. Organised by RunRio with KinetixSports as the local partner, it offered a 32 km 'Afroman' race as the centrepiece, plus 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km. Finishing the 16 km in Leg 1, 21 km in Leg 2 and 32 km in Leg 3 qualifies runners for the 42 km at the National Finals on 8 November.

core_facts.organizer: RunRio Inc. (Trilogy Run Asia), with KinetixSports as Davao partner

pros: The 32K is a supported long run with a generous six-hour limit
Completing the 32K, after the 16K and 21K legs, qualifies you for the National Finals marathon
Fast front of the field: the 2026 32K was won in 1:57:16
Medal, towel and lootbag for every finisher, and a finisher's shirt for the 21K and 32K
cons: Saturated air: 25°C and 100% humidity at the 3am listed start in 2026
No route map, aid-station list or per-distance start times published
A smaller field than the opening leg: 1,146 finishers in the 2026 results
Entries cannot be refunded, deferred or transferred
research_highlights: The Davao leg has used a consistent out-and-back course at Ayala Azuela Cove in Lanang since the series began in 2024.
Leg 3 in Davao (the September date) features 5K, 10K, 21K, and a 32K 'Afroman' distance as its centerpiece race.
Completing the progressive distances across a city's three legs (16K in Leg 1, 21K in Leg 2, 32K in Leg 3) qualifies runners for the 42K category at the November National Finals in Pasay.

The race is organised by RunRio Inc. with KinetixSports as the local Davao partner; SunStar reported about 2,700 runners at the 2024 Leg 3 and around 4,500 at the 2025 Leg 2, and the 2026 Leg 3 results list 1,146 finishers across the four distances.
research_watchouts: Participants who do not start within 15 minutes of their flag-off are disqualified, and entry fees are non-refundable and cannot be deferred or transferred.
At Davao airport, about 3 km north, it was 25°C with 100% humidity at the 3am start in 2026, rising to 29°C by 8am, inside the six-hour 32 km cut-off.

faqs.question: When is the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Davao Leg 3?
faqs.answer: Davao Leg 3 was held on Sunday 27 September 2026 at Azuela Cove in Lanang, Davao City, with a 3am start. It was the third and final Davao leg of the 2026 series, after Leg 1 on 29 March and Leg 2 on 14 June, and the last Leg 3 of the year nationwide.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Four: a 32 km 'Afroman' race, which is the centrepiece of Leg 3, plus 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km. Cut-offs were six hours for the 32 km, four hours for the 21 km, two hours for the 10 km and one hour for the 5 km, and only 21 km and 32 km finishers received a finisher's shirt.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: RunRio Inc. organises the Trilogy Run Asia series, with KinetixSports as its local partner in Davao; the Race Roster event page lists Trilogy Run Asia Inc as the contact. The series holds three legs of increasing distance in each host city, leading to the National Finals at the SM Mall of Asia Complex.
